items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the public authorities law, in relation to authorizing the
dormitory authority to provide financing to the Shelter Island Public Library
Society
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S4168

SPONSOR: PALUMBO
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the public authorities law, in relation to authorizing
the dormitory authority to provide financing to the Shelter Island
Public Library Society

 
PURPOSE:

This bill would add the Shelter Island Public Library Society to the
list of entities which are eligible for DASNY services.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section one adds Shelter Island Public Library Society to the definition
of "dormitory" in section 1676 of the public authorities law, authoriz-
ing DASNY to provide services to this library for the purposes of reno-
vation and expansion.

Section two adds Shelter Island Public Library Society to the definition
of "dormitory" in section 1680 of the public authorities law, authoriz-
ing DASNY to provide services to this library for the purposes of reno-
vation and expansion.

Section three sets forth the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This bill would extend DASNY financing and construction authorization to
the Shelter Island Public Library Society to help finance the expansion
and renovation of the library. If successful, their participation in
DASNY financing will provide stability to the project and save taxpayers
money on interest when compared with a private loan.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

TBD

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately
